title: Extension to non-text modalities
description: The Transformer was only evaluated on text tasks (translation and parsing). The authors explicitly plan to extend it to problems involving other input and output modalities such as images, audio, and video.
canonical_description: model only evaluated on text tasks, extending to other modalities is planned future work

evidence.quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
